title: Group size picker (3-4 for problem sets)
text:
Students told Tomas that 5 people is too many for problem sets: someone always ends up not contributing. Let students choose a preferred group size of 3-4 instead of the default 3-5.

**Tasks**

* Size selector in the "find a group" flow (Sam)
* Matching constraint for max size 4, with fallback when not enough students want it (Daniel)
* Copy and layout: Priya has the mockups

Keep the default at 3-5 so exam-cram groups are not affected.
